name: Anointing
overview: Scripture reveals anointing as a sacred act of consecration and dedication, symbolized by the pouring of oil upon persons or objects, as seen when Jacob anointed a stone pillar to mark a holy place. This practice extends to the consecration of priests and their garments, exemplified in the instructions to anoint Aaron and his sons to sanctify them for priestly service. The anointing oil signifies God's setting apart and empowering of individuals for divine purposes, underscoring both a physical and spiritual dedication to His service.
